scope: Raw unpatched baseline and manual-trim diagnostic only; not evidence of patched RSS recovery. Fleet measurement pending.

host.allocator: Rust System / glibc; no allocator feature or global override

metric_note: process_resident_memory_bytes is absent from this build; null throughout. RSS comes from proc status and smaps_rollup. mapping_rss_kib groups mappings by pathname and is not a live-allocation count.

settings_override.instrumentation: A diagnostic-only preload constructor allowed the parent debugger; GDB called malloc_info, malloc_trim(0), malloc_info after each recovery. No allocator override or arena tunable.

attribution_method: The original linear-memory reservation bounds identify pool mappings, including file-backed images. Secondary arena regions are 64 MiB-aligned writable anonymous mappings; 31 such regions plus brk match malloc_info reporting 32 arenas in the diagnostic. Stack-sized mappings include native and pool stacks; other anonymous and file/special mappings remain separate. Mapping RSS is not live malloc bytes. Snapshots and metrics are sequential, not atomic.
paging_note: Patched workstation runs paged and were excluded; no measured patched RSS result is claimed.
